title: Transfer known critical-complement damping with its exact limitations
statement: Lin-Xu1707.00278v1 Theorem1.1(ii),equations2.11-2.12/Lemma2.7 give projected non-anomalous damping for decaying Kolmogorov background. For a(t)=A exp(-nu0 t), set s=A t,mu=nu0/A; fixed physical T maps to theta/mu with theta=nu0 T. Thus ||(I-P)S(T)(I-P)||_(L2_vorticity->L2_vorticity)->0 as A->infinity. On the unit torus use s=kappa A t,mu=kappa nu/A,theta=kappa^2 nu T. Input H1 velocity controls L2 vorticity and Biot-Savart gives L2 output velocity; no blanket arbitrary-L2 velocity bound or recursive quantitative threshold follows. The exponential background neither returns to zero nor has rational piecewise-polynomial coefficients; approximation/removal and anomalous kernel transfer remain paid unresolved operations. CotiZelati-Elgindi-Widmayer2007.11547v1 Theorems1/4 and Section3.1 give actual near-Kolmogorov nonlinear stationary-state obstructions to naive projected-linear-to-small-nonlinear transfer for unforced decaying backgrounds. They are not a no-go for arbitrary time-dependent multidirectional controls. Metadata-only horizontal-diffusion2609.34610v1 is not a full-Laplacian premise.
